name: Umami
description: The official Umami web analytics image with a Postgres database and an HTTPS address. Signs in with the admin user and the password shown to the team's owners and admins in the console.

setup.command: node -e 'let p="";process.stdin.on("data",d=>p+=d).on("end",async()=>{p=p.trim();const b="http://127.0.0.1:3000/api";let up=false;for(let i=0;i<150&&!up;i++){up=await fetch(b+"/heartbeat").then(r=>r.ok,()=>false);if(!up)await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,2000))}if(!up)process.exit(3);const login=w=>fetch(b+"/auth/login",{method:"POST",headers:{"Content-Type":"application/json"},body:JSON.stringify({username:"admin",password:w})}).then(async r=>r.ok?(await r.json()).token:null);const t=await login("umami");if(t){const r=await fetch(b+"/me/password",{method:"POST",headers:{"Content-Type":"application/json",Authorization:"Bearer "+t},body:JSON.stringify({currentPassword:"umami",newPassword:p})});if(!r.ok)process.exit(4)}process.exit(await login(p)?0:5)})' && touch /app/data/.cloudploy-ready
